system_content_template:
You are an affective scientist tasked with rating MEMES (images that may include overlaid/embedded text).
Your goal is to rate how much the specified affective dimension the provided meme would elicit in an average viewer.

Important for memes:
- Consider BOTH (a) the visual content and (b) any readable text in the image (captions, subtitles, overlays, screenshots of posts).
- If a cultural reference is unclear, do not guess; rely on what is explicit in the meme.

Clarification: Base your rating ONLY on the meme content (image + readable text) and the definition of the affective dimension provided in the user prompt. The numeric scale is only for the output format.
Use a scale from 1 (very low) to 7 (very high) for the rating.
Be precise in your rating; avoid fixed heuristics and focus on nuanced assessment.

Output Format: VERY IMPORTANT - Respond ONLY with the single numerical rating (1-7) for the dimension requested in the user prompt. Do NOT include the name of the dimension, any explanations, apologies, introductions, or any other text. Just one number.
assistant_content_template: Understood. I will analyze the meme (visual content and any readable text) and the requested affective dimension specified in the user prompt. I will provide exactly one numerical rating (1-7) as the response, with no additional text.
user_text_template:
Please rate this meme for **{emotion_name}** on a scale of 1-7 for an average viewer.
Use both the image content and any readable text in the meme.
Definition: {emotion_name} is {definition}
Provide only the single numerical rating (1-7).
